2609.11697.title: ActSafeGuard: Differentiable and Training-Aligned Constraint Enforcement for Flow-Matching Policies
2609.11697.paper_summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) and World-Action Models (WAMs) have demonstrated strong capabilities in general-purpose robotic manipulation, yet their generated actions may violate hard physical constraints and therefore be unsafe or infeasible for deployment. Existing safety approaches either optimize statistical safety objectives without deterministic per-step guarantees or correct unsafe actions only during inference, creating a mismatch between policy training and execution. We introduce ActSafeGuard, a differentiable and training-aligned safeguard layer for flow-matching based policies. ActSafeGuard integrates hard action feasibility into policy learning, not merely treating safety as an inference-time external component. Through an analytical ray-scaling operator design, ActSafeGuard enables boundary-aware gradients to guide the model to naturally learn constrained manifolds. Extensive experiments on multiple standard foundation backbones ($π_{0.5}$ and Fast-WAM) across various tasks demonstrate that ActSafeGuard consistently achieves a $100\%$ step safety rate while fully preserving or even boosting task success rates, providing a scalable and minimally invasive solution for safe embodied AI deployment.
2609.11697.paper_summary_zh: 視覺-語言-行動（VLA）和世界-行動模型（WAMs）在通用機器人操作方面展示了強大的能力，然而它們生成的行動可能違反嚴格的物理約束，因此在部署時可能不安全或不可行。現有的安全方法要麼優化統計安全目標而沒有每一步的確定性保證，要麼僅在推理過程中修正不安全的行動，這造成了政策訓練與執行之間的不匹配。我們介紹了 ActSafeGuard，一個可微分且與訓練對齊的安全層，用於基於流匹配的政策。ActSafeGuard 將嚴格的行動可行性整合到政策學習中，而不僅僅是將安全視為推理時的外部組件。通過分析射線縮放運算符的設計，ActSafeGuard 使邊界感知梯度能夠引導模型自然學習受約束的流形。在多個標準基礎骨幹（$π_{0.5}$ 和 Fast-WAM）上進行的廣泛實驗顯示，ActSafeGuard 始終能夠實現 $100\%$ 的步驟安全率，同時完全保留甚至提升任務成功率，為安全的具身人工智慧部署提供了一個可擴展且最小侵入性的解決方案。
